Contract ProcessSaleService::endSale(): Real {
          definition:
          totalSum: Real = CurrentSale.ContainedSalesLine->collect(s | s.Subamount)->sum()
            
            precondition:
          (CurrentSale.oclIsUndefined() = false) and (CurrentSale.IsComplete = false) and (CurrentSale.IsReadytoPay = false)
            
            postcondition:
          CurrentSale.Amount = totalSum and CurrentSale.IsReadytoPay = true and result = totalSum
            
        }
